notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later. Returns the current account locale's direction, encoding, locale and name as optional strings. Direction documents ltr/rtl; omitted fields and empty strings remain distinct.

Available in cPanel 82 and later. Returns the account's available interface languages. Optional direction, local_name, locale and name fields retain their strings; local_name is the language's own name. Empty lists and omitted fields are preserved.

evidence.note: Pinned /Locale/set_locale declares x-readonly=false and x-rollback=none. Use form POST, retaining any credentials outside query strings. The response data schema is {}, so preserve present mixed data rather than inventing void or null-only behavior.

notes.text: Available in cPanel 82 and later. Changes the selected account's locale with no rollback. Supply the abbreviated locale name returned by listLocales(); the client forwards the string unchanged.
The pinned data schema is unconstrained. Preserve any present JSON value, including null, false, zero, empty strings and opaque objects; an absent data member remains a mismatch.
